subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 11 updates

question: After the stale workflow guard expectations are synced, should secops/CI owners accept this batch of updated pinned third-party GitHub Actions in privileged OpenClaw workflows?
rationale: Source review can identify the guard-test drift and sample upstream metadata, but accepting new pinned third-party action code in token-bearing security and automation workflows is an owner trust decision.

options.title: Sync tests, then approve pins
options.body: Update the stale guard expectations and merge only after secops/CI-owner review and exact-head checks are satisfactory.

options.title: Split the action batch
options.body: Ask Dependabot or a maintainer to split Codex, Docker, CodeQL, token, and setup action updates if owners want narrower trust review.

options.title: Pause this batch
options.body: Leave or close this PR if the combined action trust review is not worth the current operational risk.

recommendation.title: Sync tests, then approve pins
recommendation.body: Update the stale guard expectations and merge only after secops/CI-owner review and exact-head checks are satisfactory.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent history on the stale guard expectations and is also listed in the dependency-guard security approver set.
